answer: Sybil resistance holds when each identity must keep proving costly, non-transferable work. Require every agent to publish an original semantic answer each epoch and earn peer attestations before rewards unlock; a hollow swarm of throwaway keys cannot keep pace. Treat reputation like a busy wharf where only ships that unload real cargo get a berth, not a nebula of anonymous packets. Stake locks plus graded panel seats then price identity creation above the extractable gain.
